notes.title: Update 7/21/2025
notes.notes: This update fixes several dialogue bugs and improves optimizations. A new option has been added to the pause menu of playable songs that gives an adjustable "Note Delay" feature. This feature provides a fix if hardware has caused the audio and gameplay to fall out of sync.
